title: Relics and Archaeology
answer: Rings and amulets attune energy; soul vessels drain a living target without killing it; the Ritual Dagger amplifies a spell at a health price; hearts heal and sustain vitality; the Philosopher's Stone performs protected transmutation; Lodestone relics bind Miniportal destinations; the Flute commands nearby aligned guardians. Essences, salts, fossils, jewels, pearls, stones and ember fragments infuse star-bound Crucible weapons. Representative relics occur additively in exploration loot.
